mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona Community Park, and we have a full moon lighting up the night.

The City of Verona is busy this season with property tax bills mailing by mid-December and the Plan Commission set to review several development projects on November 4th, including additions to Ardent Glen and site plans for Milky Way.
There is a lot to do in the area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today.

In local public safety news, the Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, they arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's of Verona is the classic Turtle, and since the shop is currently open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
